findings.title: uv run pytest gate exits 1 on an environment-dependent test unrelated to the diff
findings.evidence: 05-gate.txt lines 99-100: FAILED test/test_run_review_checks.py::test_an_unwritable_worktree_parent_is_refused (Failed: DID NOT RAISE Refused); 1 failed, 1657 passed, 1 skipped. The test uses chmod 0o500 and the run used /tmp/pytest-of-root, so the process is root, which ignores directory write bits (my reading of the output). The diff changes only docs/00-working/demo-runbook.md.
findings.consequence: Manifest result is 'failed' though the deliverable is correct. Whether the test also fails on the base commit is unconfirmed because no baseline run exists.
findings.minimal_fix: Outside this phase: skip that test when running as root. Coordinator to confirm the same failure on trunk.
